subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw accept a core `/stream` session command backed by `SessionEntry.streamingMode` and the new `previewStreamingSessionOverride` channel capability for Telegram, Discord, and Slack?
rationale: The implementation adds durable session state and plugin-facing channel capability surface, so the remaining choice is API/product direction rather than only code mechanics.

options.title: Accept the core MVP after fixes
options.body: Approve the command/capability direction, then require the Discord/Slack suppression fixes and a conflict-free rebase before merge.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Limit the command to fewer channels or a plugin-owned seam if maintainers do not want a shared core capability yet.

options.title: Pause for redesign
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and ask for a smaller design proposal if the session storage or capability contract is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Accept the core MVP after fixes
recommendation.body: Approve the command/capability direction, then require the Discord/Slack suppression fixes and a conflict-free rebase before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-state and Slack streaming work makes this the best available owner for the product/API decision among the history signals inspected.
